name: Hollywood Rising Star
author: Addicting Games
description: You just got to LA with big plans to be a big star. Slasher films? Romantic comedies? Action movies? You will audition for every role you can think of. Dressing the part is the key to landing that role! Change your clothing, your hair and your makeup to suit the audition. (Green is good for zombie movies) Pay your agent for some pro tips. Nail the audition, win the role, and earn more cash to expand your costume wardrobe. Put your unique spin on a role and get more star power. Dress the part at the audition to win the role and become a Hollywood Rising Star!
